job.job_description:
If you are interested and available, please connect with me.




Large Language Model (LLM) Engineer

Location: Hyderabad (Hybrid)
Employment Type: Long Term Contract



iitjobs is hiring a Large Language Model (LLM) Engineer at Hyderabad who has experience building production-grade AI applications and deploying AI models on cloud platforms.




Required Skills:-




Python:-                   5+ years of strong Python development, OOP, APIs, multithreading

Machine Learning:- Experience building ML models using PyTorch or TensorFlow

LLMs:-                      Hands-on work with Llama, Mistral, GPT, Qwen, DeepSeek, etc.

Fine-tuning:-            LoRA, QLoRA, PEFT, SFT, Hugging Face Trainer

Transformers:-        Strong understanding of Transformer architecture, attention mechanism, tokenization

Frameworks:-          Hugging Face Transformers, LangChain, LlamaIndex

GPU Training:-        CUDA, NVIDIA GPUs, distributed training (DeepSpeed/FSDP/Megatron-LM)

Data Engineering:-  Dataset preparation, tokenization, data cleaning

Cloud:-                     AWS, Azure, or GCP

MLOps:-                   Docker, Kubernetes, MLflow, CI/CD

Coding:-                  GitHub projects, Kaggle, open-source contributions


Interested candidates, please share your resumes with janaki@iitjobs.com




Thanks and Regards,

Janaki

iitjobs, Inc.
